turns.question: Our books close on Amsterdam time. What was our revenue in September 2026, cancelled orders left out, counting each order on its calendar day in Amsterdam?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no Amsterdam-time day: revenue (Revenue (EUR), which already leaves cancelled orders out) counts each order on its UTC order date, and the query tool takes no time zone, so I cannot give the figure on Amsterdam calendar days; on UTC days, revenue for 1-30 September 2026 was 12,582.75 EUR. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
